points.title: 王子教育
points.description: 苏莱曼出生于特拉布宗，是塞利姆一世之子。在这里度过了他的童年和青少年时期，接受了全面的教育，包括学习伊斯兰教法、文学、历史、军事和科学。他精通多种语言，包括土耳其语、阿拉伯语、波斯语、切尔克斯语和斯拉夫语。这段教育为他后来的统治奠定了坚实基础，培养了他对知识的热爱和对艺术的鉴赏力，同时也塑造了他作为未来苏丹的军事和政治才能。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Trabzon, Suleiman was the son of Selim I. He spent his childhood and adolescence here, receiving a comprehensive education including Islamic law, literature, history, military science, and languages. He mastered multiple languages including Turkish, Arabic, Persian, Circassian, and Slavic. This education laid the foundation for his later reign, fostering his love for knowledge and appreciation for the arts, while also shaping his military and political abilities as the future sultan.

points.title: 早期统治
points.description: 1520年，苏莱曼继承父亲塞利姆一世成为奥斯曼帝国苏丹。最初几年，他主要在马尼萨担任总督，开始展现其统治才能。他迅速平定了帝国境内的叛乱，并开始着手改革行政和司法系统。1521年，他组织了对贝尔格莱德的成功围攻，为帝国在欧洲的扩张奠定了基础。这段时间的统治经验使他认识到军事力量与行政效率相结合的重要性，为他后来的大规模征服和改革积累了宝贵经验。
points.descriptionEn: In 1520, Suleiman succeeded his father Selim I as Sultan of the Ottoman Empire. Initially serving as governor in Manisa, he began to display his ruling abilities. He quickly suppressed rebellions within the empire and initiated reforms to the administrative and judicial systems. In 1521, he organized the successful siege of Belgrade, laying the foundation for the empire's expansion in Europe. This period of rule taught him the importance of combining military strength with administrative efficiency, accumulating valuable experience for his later conquests and reforms.

points.title: 帝国扩张
points.description: 苏莱曼将首都迁至伊斯坦布尔，开始了长达44年的统治，这段时期被称为奥斯曼帝国的'黄金时代'。他发动了一系列军事行动，1526年的莫哈奇战役击败匈牙利，1529年维也纳之围虽然未成功但巩固了奥斯曼在中欧的影响力。在地中海，他通过海军将领海雷丁·巴巴罗萨控制了北非海岸和爱琴海。同时，他进行了大规模的法律改革，颁布了《卡农法典》，规范了帝国的行政和司法体系。伊斯坦布尔成为当时世界最繁华的城市之一，吸引了来自各地的学者、艺术家和工匠。
points.descriptionEn: Suleiman moved the capital to Istanbul and began his 44-year reign, known as the 'Golden Age' of the Ottoman Empire. He launched a series of military campaigns, including the Battle of Mohács in 1526 against Hungary and the Siege of Vienna in 1529, which, though unsuccessful, consolidated Ottoman influence in Central Europe. In the Mediterranean, he controlled North African coasts and the Aegean through his naval admiral Hayreddin Barbarossa. He also implemented major legal reforms, issuing the Kanunname (Legal Code), standardizing the empire's administrative and judicial systems. Istanbul became one of the world's most prosperous cities, attracting scholars, artists, and craftsmen from across the globe.

points.title: 东方征服
points.description: 苏莱曼多次前往大马士革，指挥对东方的军事行动。1534年，他征服了巴格达，将美索不达米亚纳入奥斯曼版图，控制了通往波斯湾的贸易路线。在与萨法维波斯的战争中，他虽然未能完全征服波斯，但确保了东部边境的安全。在大马士革期间，苏莱曼还关注宗教事务，支持伊斯兰教的发展，并资助了多项建筑工程，包括修复和扩建大马士革清真寺。这座城市作为奥斯曼帝国在东方的重要行政中心，见证了苏莱曼如何平衡军事征服与文化保护，展示了他作为'立法者'的一面。
points.descriptionEn: Suleiman frequently traveled to Damascus to command military campaigns in the East. In 1534, he conquered Baghdad, incorporating Mesopotamia into the Ottoman Empire and controlling trade routes to the Persian Gulf. Although he failed to fully conquer Persia in the wars with the Safavids, he secured the eastern borders. During his time in Damascus, Suleiman also focused on religious affairs, supporting Islamic development and funding architectural projects, including the restoration and expansion of the Great Mosque of Damascus. As an important administrative center in the East, the city witnessed Suleiman's balance between military conquest and cultural preservation, showcasing his role as 'Lawgiver'.

points.title: 最后战役
points.description: 1566年，72岁高龄的苏莱曼亲自率领大军对匈牙利进行最后一次远征。在围攻锡盖特瓦尔要塞时，他于军营中逝世，结束了他辉煌的一生。这场战役虽然以奥斯曼军队的胜利告终，但苏莱曼的去世标志着奥斯曼帝国扩张时代的终结。他的遗体被秘密运回伊斯坦布尔，葬于苏莱曼尼耶清真寺旁。苏莱曼的死亡被暂时隐瞒，以确保军队安全撤退和权力平稳过渡给他的儿子塞利姆二世。这一事件反映了奥斯曼帝国军事机器的强大，也预示了帝国未来面临的挑战和转变。
points.descriptionEn: In 1566, at the age of 72, Suleiman personally led his final campaign against Hungary. During the siege of the fortress of Szigetvár, he died in his camp, ending his glorious reign. Although the battle ended in an Ottoman victory, Suleiman's death marked the end of the empire's expansion era. His body was secretly transported back to Istanbul and buried near the Süleymaniye Mosque. His death was temporarily concealed to ensure the army's safe withdrawal and a smooth transition of power to his son Selim II. This event reflected the strength of the Ottoman military machine while also预示ing the challenges and transformations the empire would face in the future.

appraisal.zh: 苏莱曼大帝被普遍视为奥斯曼帝国最杰出的统治者之一，其统治代表帝国权力与文化的巅峰，他完善法律体系、建立高效行政机构，使伊斯坦布尔成为东西方交流中心，在伊斯兰世界被誉为「立法者」，在西方则称「大帝」。不过，也有研究者指出其军事扩张造成大量伤亡，对非穆斯林的宽容仍伴随强制改宗与歧视，晚年征服塞浦路斯引发与欧洲的长期冲突，继承人塞利姆二世能力不足更被视为帝国由盛转衰的开端。
appraisal.en: Suleiman is generally regarded as one of the Ottoman Empire's most outstanding rulers, his reign marking the pinnacle of its power and culture: he perfected the legal system, built an efficient administration, and made Istanbul a hub of East-West exchange, honored as 'Lawgiver' in the Islamic world and 'the Magnificent' in the West. Still, researchers note the heavy casualties of his conquests, forced conversions and discrimination persisting alongside relative tolerance, the long conflicts with European powers triggered by his late conquest of Cyprus, and the incompetence of his successor Selim II, seen as the onset of decline.

supporter.zh: 苏莱曼大帝被奥斯曼人民尊为'立法者'，他统治期间帝国达到鼎盛，领土横跨三大洲。他完善了法律体系，促进了文化艺术繁荣，建立了高效的行政机构。在他的领导下，奥斯曼帝国成为当时世界上最强大、最文明的国家之一，伊斯坦布尔成为东西方文化交流的中心。苏莱曼的军事才能和治国智慧使他成为伊斯兰世界的骄傲，他的统治被视为奥斯曼帝国的黄金时代。
supporter.en: Suleiman is revered by the Ottoman people as 'Lawgiver'. During his reign, the empire reached its zenith, spanning three continents. He perfected the legal system, promoted cultural and artistic flourishing, and established an efficient administrative apparatus. Under his leadership, the Ottoman Empire became one of the most powerful and civilized states of its time, with Istanbul as a center of cultural exchange between East and West. Suleiman's military prowess and statesmanship made him a pride of the Islamic world, and his reign is considered the Golden Age of the Ottoman Empire.

critic.zh: 批评者认为苏莱曼的统治也存在阴暗面。他的军事扩张导致大量生命损失，如1526年莫哈奇战役中数万匈牙利士兵阵亡。他对异教徒的政策虽然相对宽容，但仍有强制改宗和歧视现象。苏莱曼晚年的一些决策，如对塞浦路斯的征服，引发了与欧洲基督教国家的长期冲突。此外，他的继承人塞利姆二世被认为能力不足，标志着奥斯曼帝国开始走下坡路，这反映了苏莱曼在继承人培养上的不足。
critic.en: Critics argue that Suleiman's rule also had its dark side. His military expansions resulted in significant loss of life, such as the tens of thousands of Hungarian soldiers killed at the Battle of Mohács in 1526. While his policies toward non-Muslims were relatively tolerant, there were still instances of forced conversions and discrimination. Some of his later decisions, like the conquest of Cyprus, led to prolonged conflicts with European Christian powers. Additionally, his successor Selim II was considered incompetent, marking the beginning of the Ottoman Empire's decline, reflecting Suleiman's shortcomings in preparing his heir.

objective.zh: 历史学界普遍认为苏莱曼大帝是奥斯曼帝国最杰出的统治者之一，他的统治代表了帝国权力与文化的巅峰。在西方，他被称为'苏莱曼大帝'，而在伊斯兰世界则被誉为'立法者'。现代历史学家评价他时，既肯定其军事成就和法律改革，也分析其统治对奥斯曼帝国长期发展的影响。苏莱曼已成为跨越文化界限的历史符号，代表着东西方交流的黄金时代，同时也象征着帝国扩张的极限与后续的挑战。他的生平和统治成为研究16世纪世界史的重要案例。
objective.en: Historians generally consider Suleiman one of the most outstanding rulers of the Ottoman Empire, representing the pinnacle of imperial power and culture. In the West, he is known as 'Suleiman the Magnificent,' while in the Islamic world, he is honored as 'Lawgiver.' Modern historians evaluate him by acknowledging both his military achievements and legal reforms while analyzing the impact of his reign on the empire's long-term development. Suleiman has become a historical symbol that transcends cultural boundaries, representing the golden age of East-West exchange and symbolizing both the limits of imperial expansion and subsequent challenges. His life and reign serve as an important case study in the study of 16th-century world history.

self.zh: 我，苏莱曼，在上帝的庇护下，成为东西方的苏丹。
self.en: I, Suleiman, in God's name, Sultan of East and West.
